title: New Orleans drummers and the press roll
summary: He discusses Noone, Baby Hall, Zutty and Baby Dodds, and explains Dodds's press roll as a controlled rebound.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Of other New Orleans, uh, drummers, do you remember any, uh, others you mentioned, Cottrell, who first came up. Do you remember any of the other bands that came up like when Joe Oliver's band first came up?

Oh, yeah. I know about Jimmy Nooney, when he first came up. And, uh, I think he was with the Joe Oliver band for a while. And then he had a band of his own very shortly after that. And then, uh, I had some wonderful drummers. Uh, Baby Hall was, uh, New Orleans drummer. And he had, he's one that had a great reputation for holding the time very steady. Uh, if he knocked off at a certain tempo, the beginning of that tempo was the same at the ending of the piece as it was in the beginning. Uh, and he, the five-stroke, uh, beat was one of his, uh, best beats. Five-stroke roll. Is that a sort of a press roll? No, it wasn't a press. It was legitimate. Now, Baby Dodds was known for the press. And, uh, it, it was really a press. And it was musical and I don't know. The nearest man to the press roll, uh, to Baby Dodds was, uh, Sudie. Oh, yeah. Sudie Samson. He could do it very near, but he couldn't, he couldn't do it like Baby Dodds.

I know Baby was famous for that press roll. I used to ask him to try to explain it a little, how he did it. And he, he would never, he could show you, but he wouldn't put it in words. Can you tell a little bit? What do you do? Just sort of drag your stick across the drum?

Uh, Baby, Baby, it was a rebound. In drumming, we have a first, one of the first things you learn to bounce your stick. You could just raise it up on the drum and drop it and just hold it loose. And it will, uh, uh, uh, it will, uh, you'll get what they call a rebound.
Uh-huh. Yeah, rebouncing. And, uh, Baby had a way that, uh, he could, uh, pause or rebound, pulling rebound. It would give it, it would just give a zzzz, zzzz, and, uh, he could control.
Just throw the stick on once and then sort of draw it.
Yeah, and draw, draw it, draw it twice.
Yeah, and keep on bouncing. Yeah. Which is a very difficult thing to do. And I never seen anyone that could do it as well as Baby.
Did both, do both hands do that? Or just the one hand?
